title: How to force a recalculation on a Purchase Order after Purchase Receipt is submitted?

posts.name: Muhammad Asif Mohtesham
posts.cooked:
A Purchase Order PUR-ORD-2025-1 has 10 items 1000001..1000010.

Multiple Purchase Receipts have been submitted corresponding to a Purchase Order Item in PUR-ORD-2025-1.

Of all the 10 items, only 3 Purchase Order Items have their “received_qty” fields set to 0, however, the Purchase Receipt document is correctly submitted and the bench console does output that all the 10 items have been received when checked manually.

purchase_order = frappe.get_doc('Purchase Order', 'PUR-ORD-2025-1')
for po_item in purchase_order.items:
    receipts = frappe.get_all('Purchase Receipt Item',
      filters={'purchase_order_item': po_item.name, 'docstatus': 1},
      fields=['qty']
    )
    received_qty = sum([r.qty for r in receipts])
    frappe.db.set_value('Purchase Order Item', po_item.name, 'received_qty', received_qty)

The above code results in the Purchase Order being corrected.

  1. What caused the received_qty fields to become 0?
  2. How to prevent such behaviour moving forward?

image1255×645 30.9 KB

This log shows that the values were updated but changed to 0 by the user, which is highly unlikely. Even if the user did change the values, what are the ways that it can be changed?
